translations.The enemy leader gets a bonus on Classic: The enemy leader gets a bonus on Classic's score. In the sandbox this wins most mirror battles.
translations.The enemy unit that has lost the largest: The enemy unit that has lost the largest share of its hit points gets a bonus, so attacks keep going to the same unit until it falls.
translations.The enemy unit with the fewest hit point: The enemy unit with the fewest hit points left gets a bonus on Classic's score.
translations.The enemy unit with the strongest attack: The enemy unit with the strongest attack gets a bonus on Classic's score.

translations.True while our side holds more than that: True while our side holds more than that share of the power on the field.
